Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O the Most High, O the Most Great
O the Most Forgiving, O the Most Merciful
You are the Great Lord
There is nothing like unto You
And He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing
And this is a month which You have magnified and honored
And You have dignified it and preferred it over all other months

Arabic text: وَهُوَ الشَّهْرُ الَّذِيْ فَرَضْتَ صِيَامَهُ عَلَيَّ
Translation: And it is the month in which You have made fasting obligatory upon me
And it is the month of Ramadan
In which You revealed the Quran

Arabic text: هُدَىً لِلنَّاسِ وَبَيِّنَاتٍ مِنَ الْهُدَىٰ وَالْفُرْقَانِ
Translation: As guidance for mankind, with clear proofs of guidance and the criterion
And You have placed in it the Night of Power
And You have made it better than a thousand months

Arabic text: فَيَا ذَا الْمَنِّ وَلَا يُمَنُّ عَلَيْكَ
Translation: O the One who bestows favors and none can bestow favors upon You

Arabic text: مُنَّ عَلَيَّ بِفَكَاكِ رَقَبَتِيْ مِنَ النَّارِ
Translation: Bestow Your favor upon me by freeing me from the Fire
Among those whom You favor
And admit me into Paradise
By Your mercy, O the Most Merciful of those who show mercy
